caption: The drawing depicts a single, mechanical object rendered in pencil or graphite tones on a plain, off-white background. The object has a conical cup at the top set onto a series of three stacked, flat, circular disks decreasing in diameter upward. From the bottom disk, five slender, evenly spaced vertical rods extend downward to a second, matching flat circular disk, forming a cylindrical open cage-like structure. Inside this cage is a single, slightly thicker central rod. Below the lower disk, the object transitions into a mechanical clamp: a curved arm extends downward, terminating in a screw mechanism for tightening, with a decorative, pointed end at the bottom. There are subtle shadows on the left side, suggesting a light source from the right. In the bottom right corner, the signature "EDWARD COOPER DEC. 6. 1938" is visible.
title: Wooden Silk Winder
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
